note: Secrets this repo requires, scoped to auditing itself. The audit enumerates 'baseline' only. This repo declares types ['source-only'] and publishes by deploying a built artifact to a host it owns over SSH, which maps to no packaging mechanism, so it carries no 'mechanisms' or 'targetMechanisms' entries. A lone routing map with nothing to route reads as a schema bug rather than as configuration. The deploy credentials are per-environment GitHub Environment secrets and variables rather than repository secrets, and are listed under 'environments' below for the operator, not for the mechanism audit.

baseline.note: The App-token secrets power the App-signed merge-bot (auto-merge that re-triggers downstream workflows), which every fleet repo runs. Used via actions/create-github-app-token with the client-id input (not the deprecated app-id). The CODEGEN_* name is historical, not codegen-specific.

environments.note: Not part of the baseline audit. Each deployment environment carries its own key so a staging deploy cannot reach production.
